# shadcn CSS

`shadcn.css` is the unchanged `dist/tailwind.css` from `shadcn@4.18.0`, the version previously pinned by this website. SHA-256: `bc7d83425702955b4cb67cb14ede9d603f9d912376d57a2d81d661094d2a782a`.

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/tree/main/packages/shadcn

The MIT license is retained in `shadcn-LICENSE.md`. Keeping this build input locally avoids installing the component-generation CLI and its registry/network dependencies just to import CSS. Do not replace these tokens or animations as part of dependency maintenance; compare and review upstream CSS separately when updating the design system.
